# Parking fines near the Main Street branch

The city of Alder Falls now enforces two-hour parking on Main Street and Cedar Avenue, and patrons have been getting tickets during long programs. Parking fines start at 25 dollars and double if unpaid after 30 days, which makes overdue tickets expensive.

The library cannot waive city parking fines. Staff can point patrons to the free lot behind the fire station, a three-minute walk. The Friends group has asked the city for program-day permits. See also [[Overdue invoices from the heating contractor]].
